I see there are AUTH* tests now too? 😄 Heya, I have a question about this test: `tests/prague/eip3074_auth_authcall/test_auth.py::test_extcodesize[fork_Prague-blockchain_test]` We fail this test. It looks like we do everything right except we set the slot of storage key 1 to 0, instead of `1` as should be in the test. This is the result of `ISZERO` after `AUTH` (so the test expects that `AUTH` somehow does not setup the stack for the right `AUTH`). However, as far as I can see it all looks correct to me 🤔 Any pointers? Is it from this PR / test? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/e3d8541625ec0c6a8d3a4a167d089761a91e8715/tests/prague/eip3074_auth_authcall/test_auth.py#L382 The poststate there looks the same as what we report? Is the blockchain test filler which filled this test perhaps wrong? Nvm Got it We don't have the extcodesize check Yet another update to the fixtures! https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/files/15336541/fixtures_develop.tar.gz BLOCKHASH gas is rolled back to 20! <@508125616940515329> <@259648573401071617> <@758579010027782144> pls tag other teams 🙏 <@486477492434239488> <@429719902363058177> <@403707149043105803> <@583892532644151312> 🙂 These fixtures are much smaller than the previous one is this correct? 111.8 MB -> 78.3? I filled it rather quickly and this one does _not_ contain the 8k block test, because it takes 30 minutes (to fill) Ah thats fine 🙂 Ok, we pass them all I'm not sure what this "BLOCKHASH gas is rolled back to 20" means though, if there is a gas schedule change then we should definitely fail some tests 🤔 There is no gas schedule change from cancun, that's what it means Besu passes these, the 8k one is where the gremlins hide. Ah ok 🙂 <@892053833121923094> Do you have tests for touching the blockhash contract after the blockhash opcode was called? That's how they currently work right now, the tx on the last block does BLOCKHASH then CALL to the contract and compares, might be worth it to add the other way around? yes Wait, just saw this PR on EIP 2935: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8564 From current EIP (so not above PR): > Since now BLOCKHASH is served from state, the clients now additionally charge the corresponding warm or cold SLOAD costs. For verkle based networks this would imply doing and bundling corresponding accesses (and gas charges) of SLOAD. We have never done this at all 😮 How come we passed the tests before? Also side-question are the state tests the same as blockchain tests except that they are now in the state test format? 🙂 8K Blocks tests I think this was implemented by geth just this week <@259648573401071617> We pass this one as well 🙂

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
Heya, I have a question about this test:

`tests/prague/eip3074_auth_authcall/test_auth.py::test_extcodesize[fork_Prague-blockchain_test]`

We fail this test. It looks like we do everything right except we set the slot of storage key 1 to 0, instead of `1` as should be in the test. This is the result of `ISZERO` after `AUTH` (so the test expects that `AUTH` somehow does not setup the stack for the right `AUTH`). However, as far as I can see it all looks correct to me 🤔 Any pointers?

The poststate there looks the same as what we report? Is the blockchain test filler which filled this test perhaps wrong?
